mainEntity.name: When can college coaches contact my kid?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most D1 sports: June 15 after sophomore year. D1 baseball: August 1 of junior year. D2: calls any time, in-person June 15.

mainEntity.name: When does D1 baseball recruiting start?

acceptedAnswer.text: D1 baseball coaches may start calling, texting and emailing August 1 of junior year; off-campus contact and visits open September 1.

mainEntity.name: When can track and cross country coaches contact athletes?

acceptedAnswer.text: June 15 after sophomore year for calls, messages and off-campus contact (changed October 7, 2026). Visits open August 1 of junior year.

mainEntity.name: When are NCAA official visits allowed?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on sport and division: D1 football April 1 of junior year, D1 track August 1, D1 baseball September 1, D3 January 1 of junior year.

mainEntity.name: What is the NCAA 10/7 core course rule?

acceptedAnswer.text: D1 requires 10 of 16 core courses, 7 of them English, math or science, finished before the seventh semester. Those grades lock.

mainEntity.name: What GPA does my kid need for NCAA Division I?

acceptedAnswer.text: At least a 2.3 core-course GPA across all 16 NCAA core courses. A transcript GPA is not the same as a core GPA.

mainEntity.name: Does my kid need an NCAA Eligibility Center account, and what does it cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: D1 and D2 recruits need a certification account ($110 domestic, fee waivers possible) before any D1 official visit. The free Profile Page is not enough.

mainEntity.name: When can a college make a written scholarship offer?

acceptedAnswer.text: D1 football: not before November 15 of senior year (rule adopted October 2025). D1 track: not before August 1 of senior year. Verbal offers are not binding.

mainEntity.name: When is signing day for the Class of 2029?

acceptedAnswer.text: Projected from current rules: D1 football early period Nov 29 to Dec 1, 2028 and regular date Feb 7, 2029; D1 baseball and track open Nov 8, 2028. Not yet published by the NCAA.

mainEntity.name: Does Division III offer athletic scholarships?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. D3 offers no athletic scholarships; aid is academic and need-based. D3 official visits open January 1 of junior year.
